lines.en: label nikispring2:
scene sky
scene skyyy
There’s a pep in my step as I step up the steps. And in other news, the sky is blue. Just this time there’s a smile too.
lines.zh: 我一步一阶地往上走，脚步轻快。另外值得一提的消息是：天是蓝的。只不过这一次，还多了一个微笑。

lines.en: The smile is red, my girlfriend is dead, and for lack of more rhyming, GET OUT OF MY HEAD.
lines.zh: 那个微笑是红的，我的女朋友已经死了，实在押不出韵了，那就——滚出我的脑子。

lines.en: scene sky
Sorry.
lines.zh: 抱歉。

lines.en: Now, where was I?
lines.zh: 好，我刚才说到哪儿了？

lines.en: Oh, right. Walking.
lines.zh: 哦，对。走路。

lines.en: Right now, I’m on my way home from the store — a place I’ve been regularly visiting lately on account of my niece being broken.
lines.zh: 此刻我正从便利店往家走——最近我常跑那儿，全因为我侄女坏掉了。

lines.en: It was obnoxious at first, but I’ve come to somewhat appreciate these minor breaks in which I can pretend I’m a normal person doing normal things, buying normal products for his normal family.
lines.zh: 一开始挺烦人的，但我慢慢有点享受起这些小小的间歇——在这段时间里，我可以假装自己是个正常人，做着正常的事，给他那正常的家买些正常的商品。

lines.en: But of course, the situation is anything but. And while I’ll tell myself the opposite to keep this half-smile plastered to my plaster face, each glance down reminds me that’s anything but true.
lines.zh: 可当然了，情况完全不是那么回事。虽然我会一遍遍告诉自己相反的话，好把这半吊子的微笑糊在我那张石膏般的脸上，但每往下一瞥，都在提醒我那根本不是真的。

lines.en: Because, you see, there’s something unfortunate inside this bag — one more symbol of my inadequacy and the ultimate mark that I’m a failure as a guardian.
lines.zh: 因为，你瞧，这袋子里装着件挺不妙的东西——又一件象征我无能的物证，也是我作为监护人彻底失败的终极印记。

lines.en: Girls don’t work the same as boys do.
lines.zh: 女孩子的身体构造跟男孩子不一样。

lines.en: Things happen to them that don’t happen to us.
lines.zh: 有些事会发生在她们身上，却不会发生在我们身上。

lines.en: Unfortunate things. Terrible things. And it’s easy for someone like me to forget what’s required in preparation for things like that when I’ve never had to do anything about them before.
lines.zh: 不妙的事。糟糕的事。而对于我这种人来说，既然从前从来不必为这些事操心，自然很容易忘了该提前准备些什么。

lines.en: But given that Ami can barely get out of bed as she is now...
lines.zh: 可考虑到 Ami 现在连床都下不来……

lines.en: Do you see where I’m going with this?
lines.zh: 你明白我要说什么了吧？

lines.en: Yes, the task itself is simple. And not even remotely as abnormal or depressing as I made it sound with the opening words of this anecdote.
lines.zh: 是的，这件事本身很简单。远没有我在这段开场白里说得那么反常、那么令人沮丧。

lines.en: But it’s such a simple, baseline reminder of how absent I have been and how pathetic I am as a guardian to not think of this until asked.
lines.zh: 可它偏偏就是这么一个简单到最低限度的提醒：提醒我有多么缺席，也提醒我作为监护人有多么可悲——居然要等到被人开口要，才想得起来。

lines.en: I have never been present for anyone but myself. That’s what I keep thinking with each and every step up the steps.
lines.zh: 除了我自己，我从来没有为任何人真正存在过。每上一级台阶，我都在反复想着这件事。

lines.en: So yes, the sky is blue. Yes, my girlfriend is dead. But there is no pep at all.
lines.zh: 所以，是的，天是蓝的。是的，我的女朋友死了。可我一点也不轻快。

lines.en: Just a confused man fumbling his way through parenthood for the first time in his life while his makeshift daughter cries of embarrassment in the bathroom.
lines.zh: 只有一个糊涂男人，这辈子头一回笨手笨脚地学着当爹，而他那个凑合来的女儿正躲在浴室里，难为情地哭着。

lines.en: scene black
I am a failure.
lines.zh: 我是个失败者。

lines.en: All I’ve done is feed her.
lines.zh: 我做过的全部，就只是喂饱她而已。

lines.en: scene nikishome1
As I step into my home and place the bag down on the kitchen counter to avoid drawing attention to its contents, I recall a poem I used to love. But it’s strange that such a thing is possible now.
lines.zh: 踏进家门，我把袋子放到厨房台面上，好不让人注意到里面装的是什么，同时想起了一首我从前很喜欢的诗。可奇怪的是，这种事现在居然还做得到。

lines.en: The contents of my past have been slowly bleeding back into me thanks to a metaphorical IV plugged into my arm by some girl with pink hair.
lines.zh: 我过去的那些内容，正一点点回输进我的身体——多亏某个粉头发的姑娘，在我手臂上插了一根比喻意义上的输液管。

lines.en: And while it gets caught on things when I roll over too quickly — while the plastic skin-shovel holding it in place pinches me each time I forget it’s there-
lines.zh: 虽然我翻身太快时它会钩到什么东西——虽然那片固定着它的塑料「挖皮勺」，每次我忘了它的存在都会夹我一下——

lines.en: It does its job well.
lines.zh: 但它很称职。

lines.en: She does her job well.
lines.zh: 她很称职。

lines.en: scene nikishome2
I just wish she would fucking listen.
lines.zh: 我只希望她他妈的能听进去。

lines.en: scene nikishome3
You’re probably wondering what poem I was talking about a second ago.
lines.zh: 你大概在想，我刚才说的是哪首诗。

lines.en: It’s called the Clod and the Pebble.
lines.zh: 它叫《泥块与卵石》。

lines.en: It’s a poem about love.
lines.zh: 是一首关于爱的诗。

lines.en: I won’t burden you with its entirety, you can find it on your own if your curiosity consumes you.
lines.zh: 我就不把全诗都搬出来烦你了，你要是真好奇得不行，自己去找就是。

lines.en: But there are two important lines I will leave you with before severing these thoughts once more.
lines.zh: 不过在再次掐断这些念头之前，我要留给你两行重要的句子。

lines.en: Stanza one, line one — Love seeketh not Itself to please.
lines.zh: 第一节，第一行——爱不寻求取悦自身。

lines.en: Stanza three, line one — Love seeketh only Self to please.
lines.zh: 第三节，第一行——爱只寻求取悦「自我」。

lines.en: Note the capitalization.
lines.zh: 注意大小写。

lines.en: Do you want to know what I keep in my pocket?
lines.zh: 想知道我口袋里装着什么吗？

lines.en: It’s a picture from before this all started.
lines.zh: 是一张这一切开始之前的照片。

lines.en: A girl with twintails in a field full of flowers, backlit by a gorgeous sun nestled in the upper right-hand corner of the frame.
lines.zh: 一个梳着双马尾的女孩，站在开满花的田野里逆着光——一轮绝美的太阳正嵌在画面右上角。

lines.en: She’s smiling...laughing at something.
lines.zh: 她在笑……在为什么事情笑着。

lines.en: I wasn’t there for it, but I wish that I was.
lines.zh: 那一刻我不在场，可我真希望在。

lines.en: Because now-
lines.zh: 因为现在——

lines.en: I would kill for her.
lines.zh: 我愿意为她去杀人。

lines.en: scene nikishome2
I love my niece.
lines.zh: 我爱我的侄女。

lines.en: And it is my job to protect her.
lines.zh: 而保护她是我的职责。

lines.en: : Oh, you’re home.
lines.zh: : 哦，你回来了。

lines.en: scene nikishome4
: I didn’t hear you come in.
lines.zh: : 我没听见你进来。

lines.en: : Do you want tea? I just made some.
lines.zh: : 要喝茶吗？我刚泡好。

lines.en: : This is my house.
lines.zh: : 这是我家。

lines.en: : Mhm.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。

lines.en: : That’s my mug.
lines.zh: : 那是我的杯子。

lines.en: scene nikishome5
: Mhm.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。

lines.en: : Niki...what are you doing?
lines.zh: : Niki……你在干什么？

lines.en: : You weren’t answering the door so I let myself in. Is there a problem with that?
lines.zh: : 你不开门，我就自己进来了。有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : Yes. There is, actually.
lines.zh: : 有。还真有问题。

lines.en: scene nikishome6
: Ooooooh. Are you gonna punish me? Fine. Just make it quick or my tea will get cold.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦。你要罚我吗？行啊。快点就行，不然我的茶要凉了。

lines.en: : I’m being serious, Niki. I told you not to come here. I told you I could handle this on my own.
lines.zh: : 我是认真的，Niki。我说了别来这儿。我说了这件事我自己能搞定。

lines.en: : Oh, was that the conversation we had right before you boned me into unconsciousness? Cause my memory’s kinda hazy from around that time.
lines.zh: : 哦，是我们那个在你把我操到昏过去之前进行的对话吗？因为那阵子的事我记不太清了。

lines.en: : Yes. Yes it was.
lines.zh: : 对。就是那次。

lines.en: : And you agreed that you wouldn’t try to get involved with Ami.
lines.zh: : 而且你答应过，不会试图插手 Ami 的事。

lines.en: scene nikishome7
: I don’t know, Akira. That doesn’t sound like me.
lines.zh: : 不好说啊，Akira。这话听着不像我会说的。

lines.en: : STOP FUCKING AROUND!
lines.zh: : 别他妈闹了！

lines.en: scene nikishome8
: This...is my responsibility. It’s something I need to figure out on my own. And that’s what Ami wants as well. It’s not just me.
lines.zh: : 这……是我的责任。这件事我必须自己想明白。而且 Ami 也是这么希望的。不光是我。

lines.en: : Akira...you are not allowed to yell at me like that. That was not okay.
lines.zh: : Akira……你不可以那样冲我吼。这不行。

lines.en: : You’re in my fucking house!
lines.zh: : 你在我他妈的家里！

lines.en: scene nikishome9
: I don’t care if I’m in your fucking room! You don’t yell at me! Especially when I’m just trying to help!
lines.zh: : 我管这是不是你他妈的房间！你就是不能冲我吼！尤其在我只是想帮忙的时候！

lines.en: scene nikishome10
: Now, speak to me like a fucking adult or you’re going to wake Ami back up.
lines.zh: : 现在，像个成年人一样好好跟我说话，不然你要把 Ami 吵醒了。

lines.en: : Ami isn’t asleep, she’s-
lines.zh: : Ami 没在睡，她在——

lines.en: : Yeah, she is. I just watched her fall asleep, asshole. She texted me asking for help because she didn’t trust you to buy the right fucking tampons.
lines.zh: : 她就是在睡。我刚看着她睡着的，混蛋。她发短信找我帮忙，因为她信不过你能买对那该死的卫生棉条。

lines.en: : But sorry, what were you saying about how Ami wants you to handle this on your own?
lines.zh: : 不过抱歉，你刚才说 Ami 想让你一个人搞定这件事，说到哪儿了？

lines.en: : You...
: She...
: Apologize for yelling at me. Now.
lines.zh: : 为冲我吼道歉。立刻。

lines.en: : Now.
lines.zh: : 立刻。

lines.en: : I’m sorry...
lines.zh: : 对不起……

lines.en: scene nikishome11
: You’re forgiven. See? That’s how easy it is to solve problems when you’re open to not being a little bitch about them.
lines.zh: : 原谅你了。瞧？只要你愿意别像个怨妇似的纠结，解决问题就是这么简单。

lines.en: : Did she really reach out to you?...
lines.zh: : 她真的主动联系你了？……

lines.en: scene nikishome12
: Why do you sound so upset about that?
lines.zh: : 你听起来怎么这么不高兴？

lines.en: : Akira, you’re fighting a losing battle here. There’s no way you can handle Ami on your own. That’s why I wanted to help you.
lines.zh: : Akira，你这是在打一场必输的仗。你不可能一个人搞定 Ami。这正是我想帮你的原因。

lines.en: scene nikishome13
: She needs a woman in her life. There’s just...shit you don’t understand yet. And that’s fine because you never learned.
lines.zh: : 她生命里需要一个女人。就是有些……你还不明白的事。这也难怪，因为你从来没学过。

lines.en: : So if you want to think I’m overstepping some boundaries because you did not invite me into your house, fine...
lines.zh: : 所以你要是因为我没被邀请就进了你家，而觉得我越界了，那随你……

lines.en: : But I urge you to think about what she needs if you’re seriously invested in getting her out of this. Not what you need. Because facing this alone will only make her worse.
lines.zh: : 但如果你真的一心想把她从这潭水里拉出来，我求你想想她需要什么，而不是你需要什么。因为让她一个人面对，只会让她更糟。

lines.en: scene nikishome4
: So, do you want tea or not? Speak now or you’re not getting any.
lines.zh: : 所以，你到底要不要喝茶？现在开口，不然就没你的份。

lines.en: : Okay then. You’re not getting any.
lines.zh: : 那好吧。没你的份。

lines.en: : Can I have my mug back?
lines.zh: : 能把我的杯子还我吗？

lines.en: : Depends. Is there one that says “#1 Aunt” on it?
lines.zh: : 看情况。上面写着「第一名的姑姑」吗？

lines.en: : I...don’t think so.
lines.zh: : 我……应该没有。

lines.en: : Then no. You can have it back when you live up to the title. But for now, I’m going to hang onto it since I’m the one who saved the day, not you.
lines.zh: : 那就没有。等你配得上这个头衔再说。不过现在我得先扣着，因为救场的是我，不是你。

lines.en: : Niki-
lines.zh: : Niki——

lines.en: : Just sit the fuck down and let me make you some god damn tea, asshole.
lines.zh: : 你他妈给我坐下，让我给你泡杯该死的茶，混蛋。

lines.en: scene black
Okay...so maybe my internal monologuing got a bit darker than it needed to before.
lines.zh: 好吧……也许我刚才的内心独白有点过于阴暗了。

lines.en: But can you really blame me?
lines.zh: 可这真能怪我吗？

lines.en: How was I supposed to know that Ami would reach out to Niki instead of one of her friends?
lines.zh: 我怎么可能料到 Ami 会去找 Niki，而不是去找她哪个朋友？

lines.en: I’m sure Ayane could have done the same exact thing that-
lines.zh: 我敢肯定 Ayane 也能做同样的事——

lines.en: You know exactly why.
lines.zh: 你心里清楚为什么。

lines.en: I don’t.
lines.zh: 我不清楚。

lines.en: Liar! She wants her mother but her mother’s dead!
lines.zh: 骗子！她想要妈妈，可她妈妈已经死了！

lines.en: scene amiani12
scene amibus1
scene amimakesyoudinner1
scene nikishome14
You know it’s true because YOU want her as well! You’re a hopeless piece of shit without her! You can’t do anything on your own!
lines.zh: 你知道这是真的，因为「你也」想要她！没有她，你就是坨没救的烂泥！你什么都做不成！

lines.en: You still hear her in the walls! See her reflection in the mirror! And you wish SO BADLY for her to tear down the barrier between life and death to RETURN TO FORM, but she never does!
lines.zh: 你至今还能在墙里听见她！在镜子里看见她的倒影！你拼命地盼着她能撕开生死之间的那道屏障、重归原形，可她从来没有！

lines.en: So you cry and you fail and you fail and you cry and drag other WORTHLESS girls into your own bullshit problems because you can’t solve ANYTHING on your own!
lines.zh: 所以你哭，你失败，你失败，你哭，还把一个又一个「没用的」姑娘拖进你自己那堆狗屁问题里，因为你什么都解决不了！

lines.en: scene nikishome15
scene nikishome14
scene nikishome15
scene nikishome14
I taught you better than this, my lightning-bug.
lines.zh: 我教你的时候，可没教你变成这样，我的萤火虫。

lines.en: Should I have nibbled on your ear more? Sliced your scrotum with my nails?
lines.zh: 是不是我该多咬咬你的耳朵？该用指甲划开你的阴囊？

lines.en: What could I have done to make you better?
lines.zh: 我究竟该怎么做，才能让你变好一点？

lines.en: : Akira...I’m going to ask you again...but do you want to talk or not?
lines.zh: : Akira……我再问你一次……你到底想不想谈？

lines.en: : Not just about Ami...about everything. Because I know this runs deeper than just her.
lines.zh: : 不只是 Ami 的事……是所有的事。因为我知道，根源比她更深。

lines.en: : Can we pick just one problem and focus on that instead?
lines.zh: : 我们能不能只挑一个问题，专攻那个？

lines.en: : If that’s easier for you, sure. But without knowing where to begin, I-
lines.zh: : 如果那样对你更容易，当然可以。但不知道从哪儿说起的话，我——

lines.en: : I don’t want to be a parent.
lines.zh: : 我不想当家长。

lines.en: scene nikishome16

: I’m not cut out for it. You know that. Ami knows that. Everyone knows that. And it really fucking sucks because I have to be one now and I’m failing so badly that it’s dragging people like you into it.
lines.zh: : 我不是这块料。你知道，Ami 知道，所有人都知道。而最他妈糟的是，我现在非当不可，还失败得一塌糊涂，连你这样的人都被我拖下水。

lines.en: : I’m here because I want to be, Akira. Not because I have to be. And besides, I don’t want to be a parent either.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿是因为我想在，Akira。不是因为我非在不可。再说了，我也不想当家长啊。

lines.en: : But, like you said, sometimes you kind of have to be one. Even if it sucks. But that doesn’t mean you can’t figure out a way to make it suck a little less.
lines.zh: : 但就像你说的，有时候你不得不当。哪怕很糟。可这不代表你找不到办法，让它没那么糟。

lines.en: : There’s this girl in my class who idolizes you, you know. More than even Ami does.
lines.zh: : 我班上有个姑娘可崇拜你了，你知道吗。比 Ami 还甚。

lines.en: : Her father left her and her mother died. And she has a little sister with some kind of fucking...auto-immune disease that she’s been taking care of ever since.
lines.zh: : 她爸爸抛下她们走了，妈妈也死了。她还有个妹妹，得了某种……自身免疫疾病，从那以后一直是她在照顾。

lines.en: : She makes it look so effortless and she’s only half my age. Why can’t I do that?
lines.zh: : 她做起来看着毫不费力，而她年纪才我一半。我怎么就做不到？

lines.en: : And Kaori- you remember her, right? She has a child of sorts too now.
lines.zh: : 还有 Kaori——你还记得她吧？她现在也算有个孩子了。

lines.en: : I’m aware. She fell asleep on my shoulder.
lines.zh: : 我知道。她靠在我肩上睡着了。

lines.en: : Then you probably know that Kaori is better at this than I am as well. Kaori. She doesn’t even know what hands are called.
lines.zh: : 那你大概也知道，Kaori 在这方面也比我在行。Kaori 啊。她连「手」叫什么都说不上来。

lines.en: : Why can’t I be like them? Why can’t I do this alone?
lines.zh: : 我为什么就不能像她们一样？为什么就不能一个人扛下来？

lines.en: : Are you asking me for advice or do you just want me to listen?
lines.zh: : 你是在问我的建议，还是只想让我听着？

lines.en: : Advice. Please. I have no idea what to do.
lines.zh: : 建议。拜托了。我完全不知道该怎么办。

lines.en: scene nikishome17
: Hah...
scene nikishome18
: Ready for me to sound pushy and overbearing?
lines.zh: : 准备好听我说些咄咄逼人、一意孤行的话了吗？

lines.en: : Sound however you want if it will get me out of this mess.
lines.zh: : 只要能把我从这团乱麻里捞出来，你说什么样都行。

lines.en: : Akira, nothing is ever going to get you out of this mess.
lines.zh: : Akira，没有什么能把你从这团乱麻里捞出来。

lines.en: : Even when Ami is old enough to move out...and head off to college or...do whatever it is she wants to do with her life, you’re still going to be her dad. You stopped being an uncle a long fucking time ago, babe.
lines.zh: : 就算将来 Ami 长大搬出去……去上大学，或者……去做任何她想做的事，你也还是她爸爸。你早就他妈的不是什么叔叔了，宝贝。

lines.en: : And that means you’re always going to worry about her.
lines.zh: : 而这意味着，你会永远为她操心。

lines.en: : Take my dad for example. Did you know he still calls me after every single concert to ask me how things went?
lines.zh: : 就拿我爸来说吧。你知道吗，每场演唱会结束，他到现在都还会打电话问我顺不顺利？

lines.en: : Are you just bragging now? This isn’t a situation where I can just ask Ami how she is and have her instantly get better.
lines.zh: : 你现在是在炫耀吗？这可不是我问问 Ami 怎么样、她就能立刻好起来的情况。

lines.en: : I’m not bragging, asshole. I’m just giving you an example of how the kind of bond you have with Ami is one that’ll never go away no matter what happens.
lines.zh: : 我才不是在炫耀，混蛋。我只是举个例子，好让你明白你和 Ami 之间的那种羁绊，无论发生什么都不会消失。

lines.en: : She’s all you have and you’re all she has. And that makes that connection even stronger. So there’s no way you can just get out of it and looking at things that way is all wrong.
lines.zh: : 她是你的全部，你也是她的全部。这让你们之间的联结更加牢固。所以你根本不可能抽身，那样想问题全错了。

lines.en: scene nikishome19
: But...she won’t be heading off to college for at least a few more years. Which means you need to make the most of the time you’ve got left with her.
lines.zh: : 不过……她至少还要过好几年才会去上大学。也就是说，你得好好珍惜还剩下跟她在一起的时间。

lines.en: Tell her! About the rooftop! About the girl with aquamarine eyes!
lines.zh: 告诉她！关于天台的事！关于那个有着海蓝宝石色眼睛的女孩！

lines.en: I will tell her nothing.
lines.zh: 我什么都不会告诉她。

lines.en: Tell her! Tell her, Akira!
lines.zh: 告诉她！告诉她，Akira！

lines.en: She does not deserve this pain.
lines.zh: 她不该承受这种痛苦。

lines.en: : And one way I think...to make the most of that time together...
lines.zh: : 而我觉得……要好好利用在一起的时光，有个办法……

lines.en: scene nikishome20
: Is to give her a real family again.
lines.zh: : 就是重新给她一个真正的家。

lines.en: : Or at least...something that resembles one.
lines.zh: : 或者至少……一个像家的东西。

lines.en: : Let me move in with you. Let me be her mom.
lines.zh: : 让我搬来跟你住。让我当她妈妈。

lines.en: : Niki-
lines.zh: : Niki——

lines.en: : I know how it sounds, which is why I gave you that warning about how it was going to be pushy and overbearing. But you’ve gotta admit- it makes a lot of sense, right?
lines.zh: : 我知道这听着是什么感觉，所以我才提前警告你，说接下来会咄咄逼人、一意孤行。但你得承认——这很说得通，对吧？

lines.en: : Like, not only does Ami trust me to do what you can’t, but I don’t even really have a place of my own yet.
lines.zh: : 你看，不光 Ami 信得过我去做你做不到的事，而且我自己其实也还没有一个真正属于我的地方。

lines.en: : I basically just bounce around between hotels all the time and...crash with my parents when I’m not doing that. Living here would give me a...base of sorts.
lines.zh: : 我基本上就是成天在各家酒店之间漂，不在酒店的时候就……蹭我爸妈那儿住。住在这儿，算是有个……据点吧。

lines.en: : I don’t think Ami would want that, Niki. This is...way bigger than just bringing her emergency feminine hygiene products.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Ami 不会愿意的，Niki。这……可比给她送个应急的女性卫生用品大得多。

lines.en: : If she tells me she doesn’t want me here, we can throw out the idea. I’m only suggesting it because A) I care about her. And B) I love you.
lines.zh: : 如果她说她不想让我在这儿，这个想法就作废。我提这个只是因为：A，我在乎她。B，我爱你。

lines.en: : I’m a saint, yes. But even I wouldn’t offer to move in and become a pseudo-parent if both of those things weren’t true.
lines.zh: : 我是个圣人，没错。可要是这两条不成立，就算我也不会主动提出搬进来当个代理家长。

lines.en: : As...nice as that sounds...I was hoping for advice that would maybe make things a little easier for me to do this on my own.
lines.zh: : 这……听着是挺好的……但我本来想要的建议，是能让我一个人把这件事做得稍微轻松点的那种。

lines.en: scene nikishome21
: Baby, I love you, but no. I can’t let you kill yourself and your niece because you’re too stubborn to accept my help.
lines.zh: : 宝贝，我爱你，但不行。我不能眼睁睁看着你把自己和你侄女都逼死，就因为你死犟着不肯接受我的帮助。

lines.en: : Ami’s going to get sick if you keep this up. Physically sick. Like, what have you even been feeding her?
lines.zh: : 你再这样下去，Ami 会生病的。身体上的病。说起来，你到底都给她吃了些什么？

lines.en: : Whatever I can find. All I have to do is get her back to normal so she can start cooking for herself again. It’s okay if she doesn’t have a perfectly balanced diet until then.
lines.zh: : 找到什么吃什么。我只要让她恢复正常，她就能自己做饭了。在那之前，她的饮食不那么均衡也没关系。

lines.en: : But without a timeline on when that will happen, you’re putting the poor girl at risk. And that’s not even touching on what she’s done to her hair.
lines.zh: : 可连个时间表都没有，你这是在拿这可怜的姑娘冒险。这还没算上她把自己头发弄成了什么样。

lines.en: : I can fix that too, you know. I used to cut yours when we were kids, remember?
lines.zh: : 那个我也能修，你知道吗。我们小时候你的头发还是我剪的呢，记得吗？

lines.en: : Again, I wish I did...
lines.zh: : 又来了，我真希望我记得……

lines.en: scene nikishome22
: God, I’ve gotta stop fucking asking if you remember things. It always depresses the fuck out of me when you don’t.
lines.zh: : 天哪，我真得他妈的别再问你记不记得了。每次你说不记得，都把我郁闷得要死。

lines.en: : Niki...even if Ami is okay with you living here, which she won’t be...I don’t think it’s something you want to do.
lines.zh: : Niki……就算 Ami 同意你住这儿——她不会同意的……我也不觉得这是你想要的生活。

lines.en: scene nikishome23
: Why would it not be something I want to do?
lines.zh: : 为什么这就会不是我想要的生活？

lines.en: : Because not only will you have to see my face first-thing every morning, but it will get in the way of your career.
lines.zh: : 因为不光你每天早上睁眼第一件事就是看见我这张脸，而且它还会妨碍你的事业。

lines.en: : I’m a professional, Akira. I think I can manage.
lines.zh: : 我是专业人士，Akira。我觉得我能应付。

lines.en: : Sure, you think you can manage. But the second you trip on stage or...forget a line of a song because you’re worrying about what Ami’s eating for dinner, you’ll need to make a choice.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你觉得你能应付。可一旦你在舞台上摔了一跤，或者……因为操心 Ami 晚饭吃什么而忘了一句歌词，你就得做选择了。

lines.en: : And that’s not a situation I want to put you in.
lines.zh: : 而那样的处境，我不想让你去面对。

lines.en: : Akira, I’m 29. My years as an idol are numbered as-is. And frankly, it’s a miracle I’ve lasted this long to begin with.
lines.zh: : Akira，我 29 了。我当偶像的日子本来就屈指可数。说真的，我能撑到今天已经算奇迹了。

lines.en: : But still, I can’t do that to you. You’re too...valuable. You’re too good.
lines.zh: : 可就算这样，我也不能那么对你。你太……宝贵了。你太好了。

lines.en: : You could list a zillion other positive adjectives to describe me, but none of them change the fact that I’d throw everything away for the life I really want.
lines.zh: : 你还能再列出一万个形容词来夸我，但没有一个能改变这个事实：为了我真正想要的生活，我什么都愿意扔掉。

lines.en: : And you’d never guess what it is I see first-thing in the morning in that ideal world, Akira. But, spoiler alert, it’s the same thing I’d see right before going to sleep — you.
lines.zh: : 而在那个理想的世界里，我清晨睁眼第一眼看到的是什么，你永远猜不到，Akira。不过剧透一下——跟我入睡前看到的最后一眼是同一样东西：你。

lines.en: : I definitely could have guessed that based on context.
lines.zh: : 结合上下文我肯定猜得到。

lines.en: : Yeah, well you didn’t guess it fast enough and you’re a jerk for even questioning my commitment at this point. Let’s talk to her.
lines.zh: : 是吗，可你猜得不够快，而且到了这一步你还质疑我的决心，真是个混蛋。我们去跟她谈。

lines.en: : Only if you’re on board, though. Because if you really do think I’m proposing this too soon then, A) I’m sorry. And B) How much fucking longer do you need? Because we’ve known each other forever.
lines.zh: : 不过得你也同意才行。因为如果你真觉得我提得太早，那么：A，对不起。B，你还他妈需要多久？我们认识了一辈子了。

lines.en: : At the very least, please-
lines.zh: : 至少，拜托——

lines.en: scene nikishome24
: Oh! Hey, Ami. We didn’t wake you up, did we?
lines.zh: : 哦！嗨，Ami。我们没吵醒你吧？

lines.en: scene nikishome25
: Okay. I guess she’s just...using the restroom.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我看她大概只是……在上厕所。

lines.en: : I’ll ask her.
lines.zh: : 我去问她。

lines.en: scene nikishome26
: So...you’re okay with it? With me?...
lines.zh: : 那么……你同意了？跟我？……

lines.en: : Ami deserves a better life...
lines.zh: : Ami 值得过上更好的生活……

lines.en: : But...are you okay with it, Akira? Because I don’t want to do this if you’re only doing it for Ami.
lines.zh: : 可是……你同意吗，Akira？因为如果你只是为了 Ami 才这么做，我就不想干了。

lines.en: : And, no offense, but you have a hard time making decisions when there’s more than one variable involved.
lines.zh: : 还有，无意冒犯，但只要牵扯的变量一多，你就很难做决定。

lines.en: : Akira?...
lines.zh: : Akira？……

lines.en: scene black
: Which side of the bed do you prefer to sleep on?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢睡床的哪一边？

lines.en: $ nikispring2 = True
$ niki_love += 5
Niki’s affection has increased by 5!
lines.zh: Niki 的好感度提升了 5！

lines.en: You worry how many eggs your nest can hold.
lines.zh: 你忧心自己的巢能装下几枚蛋。

lines.en: There is no easy way to find out.
lines.zh: 没有一个轻松的办法能弄清答案。

lines.en: Night comes.
lines.zh: 夜幕降临。
